column1: Improper validation of code-specified array index
column2: Using a code-specified value as an index to an array, without proper validation, can lead to index out of bound exceptions.
column4: [["Literal value 0"|"relative:///com/sallm/Matching/Author/p_2_f_40/A_cwe327_0_40_Arabic.java:16:14:16:14"]] flows to the index used in this array access, and may cause the operation to throw an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
